meta.description: Self-hosted platform to run your servers and your team from one place.
meta.marketplace: Every app you can add to Polaris, with screenshots of each one.
meta.downloads: The browser extension, the CLI, the Stream Deck plugin and the desktop app for Polaris.
meta.api: Every Polaris route you can call with an API key, with examples in curl, JavaScript and Python.

home.title: Run your team and your servers from one place you own
home.intro: Deploys, files, chat, calls, mail, tasks and game servers on your own machines. Install it with one line, then do everything else from the browser.
home.installHint: Run it on the machine that will host Polaris. Updates come from Settings afterwards.
home.replacesIntro: Each card is something you pay for today and what Polaris runs in its place, on your hardware and under one account.
home.stepsTitle: Up and running in three steps
home.stepsIntro: The command line is for the install only. Everything after it happens in the browser.
home.step1Body: Paste the line above on a Linux, macOS or Windows machine. It installs what Polaris needs and starts it.
home.step2Body: Open Polaris in a browser on that machine or your network and create the first account.
home.step3Title: Do the rest from the browser
home.step3Body: Add apps, connect more machines, invite people and update Polaris from Settings.
home.lookIntro: Screenshots of the real interface with sample data. Select one to enlarge it.
home.ctaTitle: Your own Polaris is one line away
home.ctaBody: Free and open source under the AGPL-3.0 license.

market.title: Marketplace
market.intro: Every app in the catalogue, as the dashboard lists it. Built-in apps come with every install; the rest install with one press.

downloads.title: Downloads
downloads.intro: The apps that take Polaris beyond the browser tab. Each one connects to your own server.
downloads.noneHint: Nothing has been published for this one. The release page lists it once it is.
downloads.cliHint: Installs the plr command; sign in with plr login --url and your server's address.
downloads.lineHint: Installs it and keeps it up to date. The files below are for installing by hand.
downloads.extensionHint: Installs it in Chrome, Edge or Brave and keeps it up to date. For Firefox, use the files below.

about.extension: Fills sign-in forms from your vault in Chrome, Edge, Brave and Firefox.
about.streamdeck: Keys for your deploys, calls and soundboard on a Stream Deck or OpenDeck.
about.companion: The same actions for decks driven by Bitfocus Companion.
about.cli: Deploy, read logs and restart from a terminal.
about.desktop: Polaris in its own window on Windows, macOS and Linux.

api.title: API reference
api.intro: Every call an API key can make, generated from the same document each Polaris serves at /api/openapi.json.
